source.title: Common English words chosen for each age group (starter list). Meanings and sentences are original to this project.
source.license: Reference only (the page describes the kind of list this was modelled on). No list was copied: words, meanings and sentences were written for this project and are released with it.

words.meaning: a furry pet that says meow
words.sentence: The cat sat on my lap.

words.meaning: a pet that barks and wags its tail
words.sentence: My dog loves to run in the park.

words.meaning: the bright light in the sky in the daytime
words.sentence: The sun is warm today.

words.meaning: something you wear on your head
words.sentence: I put on my red hat.

words.meaning: a big vehicle that carries many people
words.sentence: We ride the bus to school.

words.meaning: a pink farm animal that says oink
words.sentence: The pig rolled in the mud.

words.meaning: you drink from it
words.sentence: Please fill my cup with water.

words.meaning: where you sleep at night
words.sentence: Time to go to bed.

words.meaning: a wild animal with a bushy tail and orange fur
words.sentence: A fox ran across the field.

words.meaning: a farm bird that lays eggs
words.sentence: The hen sat on her eggs.

words.meaning: an animal that lives in water and has fins
words.sentence: The fish swam in a circle.

words.meaning: a small green animal that hops and says ribbit
words.sentence: A frog jumped into the pond.

words.meaning: a tall plant with a trunk and leaves
words.sentence: We sat under a big tree.

words.meaning: a tiny bright light you see in the night sky
words.sentence: I can see one star tonight.

words.meaning: it shines in the sky at night
words.sentence: The moon is round and bright.

words.meaning: pages with a story or pictures that you read
words.sentence: I read a book before bed.

words.meaning: a round thing you throw and kick
words.sentence: Kick the ball to me!

words.meaning: a sweet treat you eat on a birthday
words.sentence: We ate cake at the party.

words.meaning: an animal with feathers and wings
words.sentence: A bird sang in the tree.

words.meaning: a bird that swims and says quack
words.sentence: The duck swam on the pond.

words.meaning: a round red or green fruit that grows on trees
words.sentence: I ate a crunchy apple.

words.meaning: a building where a family lives
words.sentence: Our house has a blue door.

words.meaning: a big animal you can ride that says neigh
words.sentence: The horse ate some hay.

words.meaning: a tiny animal with a long tail that squeaks
words.sentence: A mouse hid in the barn.

words.meaning: you drink it, and rivers and seas are full of it
words.sentence: I drink a glass of water.

words.meaning: a living thing with roots and leaves that grows in soil
words.sentence: We water the plant every week.

words.meaning: you sit on it
words.sentence: Please sit on the chair.

words.meaning: it shows you what time it is
words.sentence: The clock says it is nine.

words.meaning: a long vehicle that runs on tracks
words.sentence: The train goes choo choo.

words.meaning: a soft white shape floating high in the sky
words.sentence: A big cloud floated by.
